title: A Paper
one_sentence_summary: A compact fixture paper for exercising traceable paper-reading artifacts.

zh.one_sentence_summary: 这是一篇用于测试可追溯论文阅读产物的紧凑 fixture 论文。
quick_read: 用这个 fixture 验证 schema、证据引用、Markdown 和 HTML 渲染。

argument_map.gap: 在信任真实论文阅读前，项目需要一个确定性的论文阅读 fixture。
argument_map.core_contribution: 该 fixture 证明基于 source-map 的阅读产物可以被校验和渲染。
argument_map.method_logic: 这个 fixture 读取本地 PDF，把每条结论连接到可核查的论文证据，并生成可浏览的论文笔记。
decisive_evidence: 校验和重建命令能够生成必要产物。
limitations: 这个 fixture 不是真实科学结果。
future_work: 在真实下载论文上使用同一产物契约。

central_claims.claim: 本地流程可以构建可追溯的论文阅读产物。
central_claims.evidence_summary: fixture 使用 source_map.json、deep_read.json、note.md 和 reading_result.html 作为互相关联的产物。
central_claims.what_it_proves: 渲染器和校验器能够处理基于证据的报告。
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: 它不能证明科学新颖性，也不能证明复杂 PDF 上的解析质量。
central_claims.open_question: 真实公式和图表需要多少人工检查？

pipeline: 解析本地 PDF 并渲染页面图像。
写入 source map 和引用相同 source refs 的 deep-read 报告。

algorithm_steps.action: 解析正文并渲染页面图像。
写入并校验结构化阅读报告。

method_understanding.engineering_derivation_sketch: 这个 fixture 把阅读可靠性问题化简为：每条合成结论都必须能回指到真实的论文证据。
implementation_details: 产物存放在 paper 目录下，而不是全局临时目录。

metrics: 有证据支撑的主张准确性。
main_results: fixture 包含一条由证据支持的主张。
ablation_or_comparison_takeaways: 没有 source refs 时，报告不能说明结论来自哪里。

numeric_results.interpretation: fixture 包含一条主张，且该主张有明确证据支撑。
numeric_results.what_it_does_not_prove: 这不能证明复杂真实论文的泛化效果。

paper_profile.rationale: The fixture is a method-style pipeline test with explicit parsing, validation, and rendering evidence.

gap.text: The project needs a deterministic paper-reading fixture before live reading is trusted.

core_contribution.text: The fixture proves that source-map grounded reading artifacts can be validated and rendered.

method_logic.text: The fixture reads a local PDF, links each conclusion to quoted paper evidence, and rebuilds a paper note for browsing.

decisive_evidence.text: Validation and rebuild commands produce required artifacts.

limitations.text: The fixture is not a real scientific result.

future_work.text: Use the same artifact contract on real downloaded papers.

quick_read.text: Use this fixture to verify schema, source refs, Markdown, and HTML rendering.

central_claims.claim: The local pipeline can build traceable paper-reading artifacts.
central_claims.evidence_summary: The fixture uses source_map.json, deep_read.json, note.md, and reading_result.html as linked artifacts.
central_claims.what_it_proves: The renderer and validator can handle source-grounded reports.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove scientific novelty or parser quality on complex PDFs.
central_claims.open_question: How much manual inspection is needed for real equations and figures?

pipeline.text: Parse the local PDF and render page images.
Write a source map and a deep-read report that cite the same source refs.

method_understanding.algorithm_pseudocode:
Input paper PDF
Parse text and page images
Create source_map.json
Create deep_read.json with source_refs
Validate and rebuild note/html

algorithm_steps.action: Parse text and render page images.
Write and validate the structured reading report.

engineering_derivation_sketch.text: The fixture reduces the reading guarantee to checking that every synthesized claim points back to a real source block.

implementation_details.text: Artifacts are stored under the paper directory rather than a global temporary area.

task_context.text: The fixture application context is validating a paper-reading workflow on local artifacts.

experimental_setup.text: The workflow uses a local fixture PDF, source map, deep-read report, and rebuilt notes.

constraints.text: The fixture is intentionally minimal and should not be interpreted as a real scientific study.

transfer_limits.text: The same contract still needs testing on real downloaded papers with complex figures and equations.

key_numbers.label: Evidence-supported central claims
key_numbers.context: The fixture uses one central claim to exercise row-level evidence references.

construction_steps.action: Build the reading fixture from a local PDF.
construction_steps.quality_control: Validate against the schema and reading contract.

biases_or_limits.text: The intentionally minimal fixture does not represent parsing difficulty on complex real papers.

metrics.text: Artifact existence, schema validation, and renderer output.

main_results.text: The fixture can produce parsed artifacts, validated reports, and rendered notes.

ablation_or_comparison_takeaways.text: Without source refs, the report cannot prove where a claim came from.

numeric_results.interpretation: The fixture contains one central claim with explicit evidence support.
numeric_results.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove robust performance on real multi-section PDFs.
